items.title: Remove permanent control hint overlay
items.what: A semi-transparent black box labeled "STANCE" and "TECHNIQUE" with arrow icons is permanently visible above the virtual joysticks in gameplay screenshots (e.g., Screenshot 3, 10, 12).
items.why: This overlay consumes valuable screen real estate in the lower third and distracts from the fighters' footwork, which is critical visual information in a fighting game.
items.how: Remove the permanent overlay. Instead, make the control hints appear only during the first tutorial run or add a toggleable "Help" button that opens the Techniques menu.

items.title: Add navigation buttons to Pre-Fight screen
items.what: The Pre-Fight screen (Screenshot 2) lacks the "MOVES" and "Settings" buttons that are present in the top-right corner during the actual fight (Screenshot 3).
items.why: Players often want to verify controls or adjust settings before the countdown timer hits zero. Hiding these options creates friction and forces players to abort the fight to access menus.
items.how: Add the "MOVES" and "Settings" buttons to the Pre-Fight screen layout, matching the in-fight HUD position.

items.title: Scale virtual joysticks for landscape aspect ratios
items.what: In the landscape/widescreen view (Screenshot 9), the virtual joysticks at the bottom corners are extremely small and cramped compared to the portrait view.
items.why: Touch targets that are too small lead to missed inputs and frustration, especially on tablets or landscape phones where the screen is wider.
items.how: Implement responsive scaling for the control zone. Increase the joystick radius by 20-30% and move them slightly higher up the screen when the aspect ratio exceeds 1.8 (landscape).

items.title: Increase contrast for move point values
items.what: In the Techniques menu (Screenshot 6), the text indicating point values (e.g., "mid - Half point", "high - Full point") is rendered in a low-contrast grey font against the dark background.
items.why: Players need to quickly distinguish between high-damage (Full point) and low-damage (Half point) moves to build an effective strategy. The current low contrast makes this information hard to parse.
items.how: Change the font color of the point values to a warm gold or bright yellow to match the HUD theme, increasing visibility and contrast against the dark background.

items.title: Add exit/navigation button to Post-Fight screen
items.what: The Post-Fight screen (Screenshot 8) displays the winner and a "REMATCH" button but lacks any button to return to the main menu, access settings, or view the Techniques list.
items.why: If a player loses or wants to quit, they are stuck staring at the "REMATCH" countdown. There is no way to navigate away from this screen.
items.how: Add a small "X" or "Menu" button in the top-right corner of the Post-Fight screen to allow players to exit to the main menu or access settings.
